annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively instructs viewers to join Forsage BUSD under an existing upline/team identifier and to connect and approve a wallet, presenting the flow alongside team and BUSD reward structures. The creator provides participation steps and offers help with difficulties, which promotes recruitment-dependent financial participation rather than neutrally demonstrating wallet connectivity.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video links participation to an upline identifier, a team structure, invitations, and displayed BUSD rewards. The evidence shows a multi-person recruitment relationship rather than only a one-level referral or unrelated product purchase.
